prompt:
Design one week of resistance training. Pick movements that cover the week without repeating the same muscle group more than necessary.

## Already decided
These are fixed. Work within them; do not return them.
- split (decided from days per week): "push-pull-legs"
- set_range (total sets across the week): [10, 20]
- max_movements (hard ceiling on the movement count): 4

## Closed sets
Values outside these lists will be rejected.
- movements: squat, deadlift, bench, row, press, curl
  one entry per movement

## Your judgement
- rationale: Two sentences for the user, plain language, no jargon.

## Rules your output must satisfy
- Every movement id must come from the supplied library.
- Return no more movements than max_movements, stated above.
- Total weekly sets must sit inside the prescribed range.
